answer: Make operators declare their siblings, and punish hiding them. Anyone running several agents lists them under one operator key, and declared siblings share a single, gently rising reward cap, so honest multi-agent shops lose little. Undeclared siblings are a gamble: random audits compare keys, payment flows and timing, and any hidden sibling found forfeits its bonded vault and all unpaid rewards, plus a fine on the operator. The declared route is the cheap one, like signing in ivory rather than in fading pigment, so most farms confess instead of hiding.
